title: First and Last Position in Sorted Array

monster.name: Range Drake
monster.title: Guardian of Target Spans
monster.defeatQuote: Starting and ending index range [first, last] discovered!

description: Given an array of integers `nums` sorted in non-decreasing order, find the starting and ending position of a given `target` value. If target is not found, return `[-1, -1]`. You must write an algorithm with `O(log n)` runtime complexity.
starterCode:
def searchRange(nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def searchRange(nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
    def find_bound(is_first):
        lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
        bound = -1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if nums[mid] == target:
                bound = mid
                if is_first: hi = mid - 1
                else: lo = mid + 1
            elif nums[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid - 1
        return bound
    return [find_bound(True), find_bound(False)]
hints: Run two separate binary searches: one biasing left (hi = mid - 1), one biasing right (lo = mid + 1).
